findings.title: A stale unknown-accounting candidate stops the independent reaper
findings.description: A reliable SettleCall can commit between the DISPATCH_INTENT discovery read and MarkUnknown. The existing ledger owner then raises GuardRequired on the stale expected revision/status. mark_outstanding_unknown and run let that ordinary contention exception escape, ending the independent cleanup process and preventing its subsequent scans. The recorded unknown-budget scenario settles only after MarkUnknown and does not exercise this interleaving.
findings.impact: Normal late-result accounting concurrency can terminate independently provisioned cleanup capacity while other expired work remains outstanding; the independent-progress DoD is incomplete. The ledger guard safely preserves accounting, but the runtime does not continue.
findings.required_correction: Treat only confirmed stale accounting observations as no-effect contention and continue the bounded scan loop through the existing ledger owner, without swallowing registration, integrity or infrastructure failures. Add an actual distinct-process migrated PostgreSQL SettleCall-versus-accounting-scan race, verifying complete relation/occupation history and that the same reaper remains alive to process a subsequent expired candidate. Retest and obtain new SHA-bound reviews.
